idea.value: A personal AI assistant is shown as a soft plush character who lives in a sky world. The film plays one delegation loop in real chat UI: ask, get a short plan, hand it over, get a result and a proactive suggestion. The character's disc carries the eye from one beat to the next.

audience.value: Busy individual knowledge workers who juggle a calendar, email and tasks and would delegate admin to an assistant. The tone is consumer-friendly (plush mascot, pastel sky) rather than enterprise.
evidence: speech-text.json 11.517-15.017: the answer card lists calendar, emails and tasks, plus a three-item priority list with a meeting time
visuals/strips/s002.jpg F90-F144: productivity app icons orbit the dome
speech-text.json 25.017-28.017: a personal wellbeing suggestion, so the user is an individual, not a team admin

value.device: promise-line build with accent words, then a descent through clouds into the world
value.description: From F0 the category promise builds word by word on a pale-sky ground, a new word every 2-5 frames (F1, F3, F5, F8, then line two from F21). The defining words are in accent blue and the rest in ink, and the line re-centres as each word lands. The camera pulls back while the line builds (type shrinks from a 0.70-wide single line to a two-line block about 0.53 wide). At 1.6-2.6 s clouds rise from below and cover the type, so the first 2.6 s pose 'what is it?' and the cloud cover promises an answer underneath.

value.purpose: hook: name the category and promise
value.retentionDevice: the line is incomplete until F28, so the eye waits for the noun
value.content: Promise line built word by word, accent words blue, camera pulls back, clouds rise over it

value.purpose: world: give the product a place and a character
value.retentionDevice: reveal from under the cloud cover; icons orbit, so the frame never freezes
value.content: Floating island with a glass dome; the plush character works at a desk inside while app icons orbit; slow push-in that accelerates into the cut

value.purpose: intimacy: from the world to the character at work
value.retentionDevice: a hard cut inside a continuous push keeps the momentum
value.content: Over-the-shoulder close-up of the character at a laptop, icons drifting behind, then a bleach to the pale ground

value.purpose: invitation: the one action the product needs
value.retentionDevice: the gap between the two words opens and the character pops out of it
value.content: Two-word imperative, centred; the words part and the character's portrait disc grows in the gap

value.purpose: proof 1: the assistant reads your day and proposes a plan
value.retentionDevice: messages land one at a time; the typing indicator stretches into the answer card
value.content: Chat: user question (blue bubble, right), greeting (left), typing dots, then a white answer card with a three-item list and an offer to act

value.retentionDevice: hero-scale typing with the camera riding the caret; a cut to the send end of the same bar
value.content: Input field slides in with a cursor that turns to an I-beam; the request types at hero scale while the frame tracks the caret; hard reframe to the mic and send button

value.purpose: handoff line: the brand promise in two lines
value.retentionDevice: the send button becomes a window with the character in it; the headline builds around it
value.content: The send disc drains to white, the character rises into it, a two-line headline builds above and below the disc with the name in accent blue

value.purpose: proof 2: the task is finished, and the assistant anticipates the next need
value.retentionDevice: the portrait disc becomes the chat avatar, so the thread continues without a cut
value.content: Chat: the user's request bubble, a short 'finished' reply with a green tick, then a longer proactive suggestion with typing dots and an emoji

value.purpose: spectacle and breath: the world again, from above
value.retentionDevice: an iris opens from a disc inside the chat to an overhead ocean shot
value.content: Overhead view of the character's glass dome floating on the ocean among cloud shadows, slow pull-back

value.retentionDevice: giant letters sweep through the frame and settle into one calm line
value.content: Three-word tagline flies in at frame height, settles to a single centred line, re-colours from blue to ink and fades to a ghost

value.retentionDevice: the mark is written by a brush stroke rather than dropped in
value.content: A blue brush stroke writes a cursive monogram, shrinks to centre and holds to the last frame on the pale ground

payoff.value: The loop closes at 24.0 s: the request comes back 'finished' with a green tick, and the assistant adds an unasked, personal suggestion. Delegation works, and the assistant thinks ahead.

callToAction.value: No explicit call to action: no URL, store badge or button. The film ends on the tagline and a brush-drawn monogram held for about 2.2 s; the two-word imperative at 6.4 s ('ask') is the only instruction.

whyItWorks: One circle carries the story: the portrait disc pops out of the invitation (7.53 s), shrinks to the chat avatar (8.43 s), comes back as the send button, which becomes the portrait window (19.7-20.2 s), turns into a blue sphere that becomes the avatar again (23.1-23.8 s), and opens as the iris onto the world (28.2 s). The eye always has the same object to follow across a change.

The UI is the proof, and it is staged at two scales: chat at reading scale (text about 0.035 of frame height) for 'what it does', the input field at hero scale (text about 0.11 of frame height, overflowing the left edge) for 'what you do'.
Character and world are warm and tactile (plush, glass, clouds); everything else is a near-white sky ground #E4EFF7 with one accent blue. Product UI and brand world read as one place.
There are only three hard cuts in 34.8 s (4.93, 8.43, 18.63 s). Every other change is a morph, wipe or camera move, so the film feels like one continuous thought, which suits 'it just handles it'.

The music thins at the pivots. Onsets stop at 7.73-8.64 s and 14.56-15.91 s and are sparse at 25.98-28.51 s, and the scene changes sit in those gaps. This is measured co-occurrence; whether it is intent is inferred.
